# agy onboarding inputs

`terms-checked.pane.txt` is a text transcription of the user's 1.5.6 screenshot,
including its focused, checked Interactions-data row and visible Context footer.
`welcome.pane.txt` transcribes its wizard controls; the decorative logo is omitted
and the right-hand code preview is transcribed with approximate border widths. Neither is a raw terminal recording.
No account identifier, credential, private image or join link is included.

The screenshots alone do not establish the repainted button-focus frames or
navigation. See the sibling 1.5.7 folder for the subsequently authorised live
capture. These inputs are not a full CLI version audit.
